intersections.note: Beech Av. (50 ft, name from sheet 665 and the key map; not printed on 663) comes up from the bottom edge over the Ross Run bridge and ends at Spring Grove's south face; Spring Grove's north face is unbroken (P&G works fence beyond). notes: Single panel, rotated: the north arrow points to the upper right, so page-right is roughly NNE and page-down roughly ESE. Almost the whole sheet is the Procter & Gamble Co. Soap Works (framing houses, boiler house, reservoir, oil refinery) with Mill Creek across the upper left; no public street enters the works on this sheet. Spring Grove Av. (100 ft) crosses the bottom from the left edge (y about 5300-6000) to the right edge (north face ends at a track at about (6440,7030)); Beech Av. runs off the bottom edge (faces about x 2663/2995 at the bottom). Along the right edge is an internal works lane labelled 6TH with 50' printed (the same lane appears on sheet 664's left edge); it has no street lines, only R.R. sidings and water pipes, so it is not picked. The double line crossing Spring Grove at about (2700,6700) and Ross Run on a bridge is a railroad siding, ignored. Ross Run (creek) along the bottom left ignored.
